## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

Claim: a finite box cover of the parameter domain with Krawczyk images disjoint from every box excludes all zeros of the 180-residual system.

### Governing Obligation
No complete cover exists: the full containing boxes of the 618- and 666-equation systems are unresolved, the six candidate charts return UNRESOLVED_BOX, and only the regions in MUB6-C28 and MUB6-PAPER-CLOSE-COLUMNS are excluded.

### Witness Audit
Sound exclusion criteria exist (MUB6-C25) but no successful quartet-domain check is supplied; no 56-cell or cusp run with per-cell boxes exists.
